messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Don't worry—resetting APN settings and rebooting your phone won't affect your stored pictures or other personal data. Those are just network configuration changes.

Since your phone is in airplane mode, we need to turn it off first to restore cellular service. Please run this on your phone:
- **toggle_airplane_mode**

This will turn airplane mode OFF and restore your cellular connection. After you do that, let me know and we'll check if MMS is working.

Airplane mode is now off, but the status bar shows no signal and mobile data is disabled. Should I try to turn on mobile data next? I'm a bit nervous about what to do next.

Please complete the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
